name: 240730_2807_FR_Carillon_in_cloister
description:
Carillon in the cloister of the Men’s Abbey, in Caen (binaural, please use headset for 3D effects). 
I made this recording in the cloister of l’Abbaye aux hommes (Men’s Abbey), located in the city of Caen (north-west of France). 
At #0:21, one can hear the pleasant tune of the carillon, immediately followed by the bell ringing 11 o’clock. Then, at #2:34, the bell will ring again. 
In the background, noises and voices from tourists visiting the place, flapping wings of pigeons and some other birds. 
Recorded in July 2024 with an Olympus LS-P4 and Ohrwurm 3D binaural microphones. 
Fade in/out and high pass filter at 60Hz -6dB/oct applied in Audacity. 
(If you want to use this sound as a mono audio file, you may have to delete one channel to avoid phase issues).

name: 230429_2406_FR_DoveBuildingNest.mp3
description: Subtle warble and noise from a collared dove building her nest. (mp3 version) I made this recording during a spring afternoon, on a 4th floor balcony located in Nice city (south-east of France) while a dove was putting the finishing touch to her nest. The microphones were clipped on the side wall of the balcony, about 20cm under the nest. At the beginning of this long recording, one can hear the flapping wings of the dove coming to her nest, then she arranges it conscientiously during about 30 minutes, making some subtle noise and soft warbles. Then, finally, she decides to fly away. In the background, street ambience (some vehicles passing by, some birds and voices), airplanes flying over, light hum from the city and white noise from a fountain. Please note that this file is a MP3 version of the higher resolution (24 bits 48 kHz) recording available here : https://freesound.org/people/kevp888/sounds/686857/ Recorded in April 2023 with an Olympus LS-P4 and Micbooster Clippy Stereo EM272 microphones (Primo em272). Fade in/out and high pass filter at 30Hz -6dB/oct applied in Audacity. (If you want to use this sound as a mono audio file, you may have to delete one channel to avoid phase issues).

name: LS_34824_FR_SpringPublicGarden.wav
description:
Public park spring atmosphere, with great spotted woodpecker. 
I made this recording during a beautiful spring morning, while having a healthy walk in the wide public garden not so far from my home. (located in Nanterre city, suburbs of Paris, France) 
One can hear birds (great tits, doves, magpies, crows and others), flapping wings of some pigeons passing by, and our noisy friend, the great spotted woodpecker, who’s coming back with the spring. So nice to hear him again ! In the background, hum from the city, police siren, and an airplane flying over. 
Recorded in March 2023 with an Olympus LS-3 (internal microphones, TRESMIC system on). 
Fade in/out and high pass filter at 160Hz -6dB/oct applied in audacity.

name: 220806_2080_FR_RiversideMorning.wav
description:
Peaceful morning at riverside (3rd file). 
I made this recording at about 50meters from the side of Lot river, in the south-west of France, during à calm and peaceful summer morning, at around 7AM. 
One can hear crickets, birds (a lot of swallows, ravens, doves, rooster, magpie, blackbird, pigeons, and others), flapping wings, some cracking sounds coming from the bushes and the forest around, and in the background, an airplane flying high. 
Recorded in August 2022 with an Olympus LS-P4 and Immersive Soundscapes EarSight microphones in AB position. 
Fade in/out and high pass filter at 60Hz -6dB/oct applied in Audacity. 
(If you want to use this sound as a mono audio file, you may have to delete one channel to avoid phase issues).

name: binaural birds woodpecker.flac
description: 3D DIY binaural dummy head recording. Intended for headphone listening. Bird sounds from my garden and adjoining woods around dawn this morning, notably a woodpecker pecking wood. Other sounds - cat meowing at me (back, near start), airliner (back left to front right ~10km+,), pigeon flapping wings (inc. up, towards end), train (right ~2km.), scafolding? being moved, and some traffic (right ~1km.) Woods mainly front and left, house and hillside behind, town right (1-2km.),slightly down. Very demanding soundstage to reproduce with wide range of distances, directions, and frequency bands. Some sounds have very limited bandwidth (eg. HF air attenuation at 1Km.+ ) making localization more tricky. Good test for headphone imaging. Best on headphones, but works quite well on stereo speakers. Roland Quad Capture to PC. Unfortunately there is some audible hiss from new aux. mics, if played too loud.
